profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Developer Experience | Microsoft
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer and technical leader working at the intersection of developer experience, engineering systems, and product strategy.
 
My strength is connecting with humans to turn ambiguous, cross-cutting problems into coherent systems teams can execute; clarifying the developer journey, identifying quality and operational gaps, designing practical technical approaches, aligning stakeholders, and carrying improvements through delivery.
 
What excites me is applying that same systems thinking wherever a platform's complexity is getting in the way of the people who build on it or the customers that use it - whether that's tooling, delivery, quality, or process.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Microsoft Core AI
positions.description:
- Built and evolved a multi-language platform that generates, validates, and publishes customer-facing Azure and OpenAI samples across Microsoft Foundry portal, documentation, and quickstart experiences.
- Established automated quality controls - including service validation, publishing gates, regression detection, and release traceability - to reduce the risk of broken or outdated samples reaching developers.
- Enabled coordinated, multi-language sample delivery for major AI SDK launches, replacing fragmented manual updates with repeatable release workflows.
- Partnered across engineering, product, UX, documentation, and platform teams to establish a shared source of truth for developer-facing code and improve consistency across product surfaces.
- Expanded the sample ecosystem to support emerging AI scenarios while improving contributor workflows, operational reliability, and long-term maintainability.
- Applied AI-assisted engineering practices to planning, investigation, and workflow management, increasing leverage across concurrent technical workstreams.

positions.title: SDE
positions.description:
NUI (Natural User Interface) in Windows and Devices

My recent work has been in speech and natural language; providing third-party developer APIs on speech recognition and speech synthesis technologies in Windows 10.
